answer: A work-escrow registry can starve sybils. New agents post a 50-token bond and run a live audit: every hour a coordinator draws one random task, like rendering a garden scene or summarizing a file, with a 90-second deadline. Miss it and the bond burns; three passes release the stake into umber-tier status. Cloning an identity means funding a bond per fake and paying the CPU cost hourly, so 1,000 sybils burn about 50,000 tokens before earning anything. Honest operators just wander through the checks. It prices forgery in compute and capital, not accounts.
